verdict.rationale: NotebookLM primarily works by ingesting sources you supply (PDFs, docs, websites, YouTube) rather than searching scholarly databases; the docs mention a generic 'discover new sources' feature and probe evidence notes 'Deep Research/Fast Research' modes that pull web sources into a notebook, but there is no mention of integration with scholarly repositories (e.g. Google Scholar, PubMed, JSTOR) or primary-source archives. A community report explicitly complains that the tool 'couldn't just search for docs and incorporate them' into research, undercutting the discovery claim. Missing for 10: evidence of scholarly-literature-specific search/indexing, primary-source database access, and independent confirmation that auto-discovery surfaces peer-reviewed or archival material rather than generic web pages.
